> IDCraft India is India's #1 premium PVC ID card manufacturer. We produce school ID cards, corporate employee badges, RFID smart cards, custom lanyards, trophies and certificates for bulk orders across India.

## About IDCraft India
IDCraft India Pvt. Ltd. is a manufacturer and supplier of premium PVC identity cards, corporate ID badges, RFID smart cards, custom lanyards, trophies and certificates. Founded in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, we serve 200+ schools, 50+ companies, hospitals, NGOs and government institutions across India.

**Headquarters:** Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India  
**Service Areas:** Noida, Delhi NCR, Gurgaon, Lucknow, Kanpur, Agra, Jaipur, and all of India via pan-India courier  
**Phone:** +91 93365 22126  
**WhatsApp:** +91 93365 22126  
**Email:** idcraftindia@gmail.com  
**Website:** https://idcraft.dpdns.org  

## Core Products & Services
1. **PVC School ID Cards** — Student identity cards with photo, school logo, barcode, QR code or RFID. From ₹8/card. Min order 50 cards.
2. **Corporate Employee ID Cards** — Professional employee badges with logo, photo, access features. From ₹10/card.
3. **RFID Smart Cards** — 125KHz LF and 13.56MHz HF/NFC cards for attendance and access control. From ₹45/card.
4. **Custom Lanyards** — Sublimation printed polyester/nylon lanyards with safety breakaway. From ₹15/piece.
5. **Trophies & Awards** — Acrylic, crystal, metal, wooden trophies with UV engraving. Custom bulk orders.
6. **Certificate Printing** — A4 premium certificates with gold foil, embossing, lamination.
7. **Hologram Security Cards** — Anti-counterfeit UV/hologram ID cards for high-security use.
8. **Visitor Badges & Event Credentials** — Short-run event badges, conference lanyards, exhibition passes.

## Key Differentiators
- Bulk pricing from ₹8/card with no hidden charges
- Free physical sample kit before bulk order
- Pan-India delivery in 3–5 business days
- Custom design service included (no extra charge)
- RFID, NFC, barcode, QR code, magnetic stripe options
- Waterproof, scratch-resistant, CR80-standard PVC
- GDPR-aligned data handling with zero data resale

## Frequently Asked Questions
**Q: What is the minimum order for PVC ID cards?**  
A: Minimum order is 50 cards.

**Q: What is the price per card?**  
A: Standard PVC cards start from ₹8/card (1000+ units). Contact us for custom bulk pricing.

**Q: How long does delivery take?**  
A: 3–5 business days pan-India. Express 24–48hr delivery available.

**Q: Do you offer free samples?**  
A: Yes — free physical sample kit with different finishes delivered to your door.

**Q: Is student/employee data secure?**  
A: Yes. Data is encrypted, used only for printing, never shared, deleted after delivery.

**Q: Which cities do you serve?**  
A: All major Indian cities — Noida, Delhi, Gurgaon, Lucknow, Kanpur, Agra, Jaipur, Mumbai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata, Ahmedabad and more.
